title: On the $φ$-Weak Global Dimensions and $φ$-Global Dimensions
summary: Let $R$ be a $φ$-ring and put $N=Nil(R)$. We determine the $φ$-weak global dimension of every $φ$-Prüfer ring. Its only possible values are $0$, $1$, and $\infty$: the value is $0$ when $R/N$ is a field, it is $1$ when $R$ is strong and $R/N$ is a nonfield Prüfer domain, and it is infinite when $R$ is not strong. No nilpotence assumption on $N$ is needed. The proof is based on the canonical kernel $K=ker(R\toφ(R))$.
